newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.

text.p: Cotton prices were steady on Wednesday in dull trade, dealers said.
"There are hardly any transactions. Cotton buying by yarn mills has been very poor," said a dealer.
In spot, Bengal-deshi was steady at 860/920 rupees per maund (32.37 kgs). Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,560/1,590 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan was quoted at 13,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Gujarat Wagad was steady at 12,600 rupees per candy.
"The market undertone is weak," the dealer said.
